programme.title: Hostel
programme.desc: The story is about a girls' hostel where girls from different cities come to get an education. The hostel has strict rules and regulations, the credit for which goes to the warden of the hostel, Shaista Naz. Maha is also among the girls who came here with the dream of success in her eyes. She faces Sehar and her group, who are notorious for their mischiefs. These same things will have an impact on their future life.

programme.title: Ishq Ek Gunah
programme.desc: Kareem, a successful businessman, lives a blissful life with his beautiful wife and grown-up children. But fate has a way of turning happiness into turmoil in a single moment. One tragic day, Kareem’s loyal driver sacrifices his life in a fatal accident while saving Kareem. Shaken and indebted, Kareem takes it upon himself to honor this ultimate sacrifice. He brings the driver’s grieving wife, Fatima, and their young daughter, Nasreen, into his own home. Nasreen, a strikingly beautiful yet ambitious young woman, is quickly captivated and consumed by the wealth and grandeur of Kareem’s household. Envy takes root, and she begins to plot her way into Kareem’s heart, weaving schemes to replace the harmony of his family with her own desires.

programme.title: Rishtey Series
programme.desc: The theme of our special stories series is Relationships. Relationships without which our life is incomplete. Relationships are the asset of our life that binds us together in the rope of feelings and emotions. Relationships are the blessings of God that we do not choose by ourselves. Throughout our life, there are many colors of relationships like love, hate, friendship, feeling, trust, and every color of relationships is special. And you will see all these special colors in the series 'Rishtay' on AAN TV.

programme.title: Mera Susraal
programme.desc: It is a story of Dua who marries Nadeem Ahmed out of love and enters a household where her sisters-in-law, elder and younger, engulf their lives in the greed for wealth, poisoning the happiness of Nadeem Ahmed and Dua's joy-filled life. The elder and younger sisters always assert their dominance over Nadeem Ahmed, and he, in turn, obeys their every command. In reality, both these sisters never wanted Nadeem Ahmed to marry Dua, but Nadeem Ahmed fell in love with Dua, and they got married, dreaming of starting a new life together, which remained incomplete due to the selfishness of the sisters.

programme.title: Muqaam
programme.desc: Amber and Sehar are very close friends. Amber is a simple, homely girl, while Sehar is modern, bold, and a little selfish, driven by her love for wealth. Amber gets married to Hassan, a handsome young man who believes that an ideal life partner should be modern and bold. Although Hassan marries Amber due to his family's choice, when he meets Sehar, he sees his ideal partner in her. Hassan's admiration and constant praise for Sehar greatly please her, and she completely forgets that she is crossing boundaries with her best friend's husband. Amber's simplicity and naïve nature create the space for Hassan and Sehar to grow closer, until Hassan even decides to marry Sehar as his second wife. Will Amber and Sehar's friendship turn into hatred? By rejecting Amber's love, will Hassan openly confess his love for Sehar? When respect disappears from relationships, how can anyone find their true place?

programme.title: Solar System
programme.desc: The host of the program, Professor Brian Cox, presents selected information about the solar system.Viewers will learn about planets and moons covered with volcanoes that erupt with fire and ice.In the following parts, the scientist talks about the most interesting atmospheric conditions that were noticed on celestial bodies neighboring the Earth.He visits landscapes created by dust whirls, mountains covered with metallic frost and monsoon rains on one of the moons.In addition, Professor Cox will introduce viewers to frozen regions of the solar system, including a dwarf planet with mountains of solid ice floating on it, as well as a black and white moon.

programme.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle travels around the British Isles in search of people who gave up living in big cities and moved to the provinces to be closer to nature.

programme.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programme.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programme.title: Jimmy Doherty's New Zealand Escape
programme.desc: Jimmy takes a trip to the tropical north to visit New Zealand.His culinary discoveries will not be the only attraction of the program.There will also be a visit to the winery and a show of seasonal specialties.

programme.title: Life Below Zero
programme.desc: Alaska has extremely harsh climatic conditions.Temperatures there regularly drop to life-threatening levels.Despite this, the region is inhabited by people.The tenth season of the program presents the everyday adventures of the inhabitants of four households from different parts of the Alaskan wilderness.Their lives focus primarily on hunting and careful preparations for and struggles with the long and frosty winter.Viewers will see, among others:Agnes Hailstone, who with her daughters tries to hunt caribou while her husband is away.

programme.title: The Green Planet
programme.desc: The creators of the production invite viewers on a journey through the lush world of plants.It hides many surprising phenomena and hundreds of amazing heroes.Thanks to the lenses of specialized cameras, the mysterious life of nature's creations will be shown up close.Scientific research shows that nature is a perfect system of connecting vessels.In each of the five episodes, we will learn about a different group of plants and the secrets of their survival.The creators will talk about, among others:stories about seeds that can survive civilizations, trees that take care of each other, and creatures of nature that are as aggressive and spontaneous as animals.We will also learn about the relationships between people and animals with plants.It turns out that plants count, hunt, cheat, communicate, protect their relatives and manipulate animals for their own purposes.Contrary to appearances, when plants and animals interact with each other, it is usually the plant that sets the tone of the relationship.The series' narrator will be Sir David Attenborough, a popularizer of natural science Viewers will discover the world of aquatic plants.They create some of the most beautiful and important habitats on Earth.Life in water is not easy, which is why individual plant species have found innovative ways to survive.The color-changing algae that grows on the Rainbow River in Colombia sticks to rocks thanks to a natural version of superglue.In the Brazilian Pantanal, plants fight for light using air bags.Their goal is to stay afloat and reproduce quickly.The globe seaweed, which comes from Japan, uses the water currents of Lake Akan to move to an ideal place for development.During the flowering period, aquatic plants behave like terrestrial plants for a time, displaying flowers into the air on stiff stems.Only one flowering plant has reached the sea and forms underwater communities - seagrass.Its submerged savannahs not only support large numbers of animals, but also sequester carbon dioxide 35 times faster than tropical forests.Now under threat, they are crucial in the fight against climate change.

programme.title: My Family 3
programme.desc: Ben (Robert Lindsay) and Susan (Zoë Wanamaker) Harper are a middle-class couple living in the Chiswick district of London.Their three children live with them: Nick (Kris Marshall), Janey (Daniela Denby-Ashe) and Michael (Gabriel Thomson).Ben is a dentist who values ​​peace and quiet.Susan makes all the important decisions in the family.She works in London as a tour guide and has a hard time adapting to the stereotype of a woman cooking dinner for her husband.The eldest son, Nick, is not very bright, has problems finding a permanent job and spends most of his time in front of the TV.Janey is only interested in clothes and boys, and the youngest, Michael, is an intelligent boy and the mascot of the whole family.He doesn't find a common language with his father, but spends all day in front of the computer.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's \"influencer hotspots.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Young dancer of Batang melody
programme.desc: Tibetan girl Tashi Badro from Batang, Ganzi, Sichuan has learned how to do the Xianzi dance both from her mom and a school program. Batang Xianzi is a unique folk dance of the Tibetan ethnic group with a history spanning over 1,000 years on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. In order to keep the Tibetan tradition alive, Badro’s school has offered the dance as a cultural activity. Badro said dancing with her classmates is the happiest moment of her day. Watch the graceful movements of Badro and her peers performing the Xianzi dance.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of \"lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature.\nTulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint.\nA tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: Awakening Lion-1
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

Watch the graceful movements of Badro and her peers performing the Xianzi dance.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's \"influencer hotspots.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Young dancer of Batang melody

Watch the graceful movements of Badro and her peers performing the Xianzi dance.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of \"lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature.\nTulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint.\nA tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: Awakening Lion-1
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Guqin Music Art
programme.desc: The guqin is an instrument with a history of over 3,000 years. Yet in all that time, its design and sound have remained virtually unchanged. In 2003, the guqin and its music were proclaimed as part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO. But how has this ancient instrument withstood the musical test of time? How do its slow, gentle melodies resonate in fast-paced modern China? In this episode of The Inheritors, we explore guqin music art’s history, development in modern days, and its future.

programme.title: Face-changing wonder boy
programme.desc: Face-changing is an ancient Chinese performance art that is a component of Sichuan opera. Hu Yibo, 13, learned the act from his grandfather and other experienced masters. Dressed in brightly-colored costumes and while changing from one mask to another in just the blink of an eye, Yibo skillfully swipes open a fan to hide his \"magical\" movements. As a young inheritor, he undertakes daily training to perfect his skill set in the hope of becoming a master one day.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous \"mala\" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview \"the Monkey Father\"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

We interview \"the Monkey Father\"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Face-changing wonder boy
programme.desc: Face-changing is an ancient Chinese performance art that is a component of Sichuan opera. Hu Yibo, 13, learned the act from his grandfather and other experienced masters. Dressed in brightly-colored costumes and while changing from one mask to another in just the blink of an eye, Yibo skillfully swipes open a fan to hide his \"magical\" movements. As a young inheritor, he undertakes daily training to perfect his skill set in the hope of becoming a master one day.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.\nFrom the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: B-girl's power moves
programme.desc: Meet Gao Ya, a 10-year-old girl from Fuqing, Fujian, who goes by the stage name Gao Xing, which means to be happy. She started her break-dancing journey when she was five and has been practicing non-stop ever since. Now as a rising star in her dance squad, she has unlocked many new moves and is ready to take her skill set one step higher.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: The Great British Theft?
programme.desc: The Parthenon, the crown jewel of Athens, is a 2,500-year-old UNESCO World Heritage Site. Two centuries ago, Lord Elgin dismantled nearly half of its sculptures under false pretense and shipped them back to the British Museum. Today, the Acropolis Museum holds only a fraction of its originals. In this documentary, CGTN visits both sites to pose a candid question. Were his actions in the spirit of preservation, or was it just plunder.

programme.desc: Spanning livelihoods, industry, and ecological governance, this documentary reveals a people-centered philosophy in action, showing how national development becomes tangible happiness, while capturing the powerful warmth of progress.

Take in the majesty of the Potala Palace, discover intangible cultural heritage skills such as Tibetan paper making and Tibetan incense, and experience the plateau's natural wonders in a whole new light.

programme.title: The Blue World Ep.6
programme.desc: As China’s first panoramic marine documentary, this series brings coastal waters onto the cinematic stage. Combining breathtaking imagery with compelling narratives, it reveals the ecology, resources, and vibrant life existing within China’s mysterious blue frontiers.

programme.title: Journey of the Chili Pepper Ep.5

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application?\nJoin BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: Global business voices on China-US trade relations
programme.desc: China-US relations draws global attention, the global business community is closely watching what US President Donald Trump's visit to China means for trade, investment and market confidence.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, CGTN’s Lincoln Humphries sits down with Fred Teng, president of the AmericaChina Public Affairs Institute, Chris Torrens, chairman of the British Chamber of Commerce in China, and Oliver Oehms, executive director and board member of the German Chamber of Commerce in China – North China; exploring investment sentiment, business trends and why China-US cooperation still matters in an uncertain global economy.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programme.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programme.title: Around China: Explore Lijiang's vibrant nighttime economy with Naxi culture
programme.desc: In recent years, Lijiang, Yunnan Province, has been leveraging its unique local resources to enrich and elevate its nighttime economy. By promoting activities such as nighttime dining, scenic views, and evening performances, Lijiang has unleashed vibrant consumer energy, attracting a growing number of tourists. Join CGTN Reporter Zhu Zhu to immerse in the Naxi ethnic wear, taking part in a bonfire party at Sifang Street, and explore Lijiang’s nighttime economy firsthand.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programme.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programme.title: Around China: Explore Lijiang's vibrant nighttime economy with Naxi culture
programme.desc: In recent years, Lijiang, Yunnan Province, has been leveraging its unique local resources to enrich and elevate its nighttime economy. By promoting activities such as nighttime dining, scenic views, and evening performances, Lijiang has unleashed vibrant consumer energy, attracting a growing number of tourists. Join CGTN Reporter Zhu Zhu to immerse in the Naxi ethnic wear, taking part in a bonfire party at Sifang Street, and explore Lijiang’s nighttime economy firsthand.

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. programme.title: Road absurdities 4
programme.desc: In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face. Kamil and Krzysiek will go to Warsaw by Mermaid from Kutno, where they will look at the constructions in Żoliborz resembling a city race track and try to count the cones on the Toruńska Route and on the Hel Coast near the zoo.The next stop is Żyrardów: the bicycle path ends there so that road users are at risk of a head-on collision, and a wrongly set speed limit sign near the cemetery means that you can drive at 40 km/h in one direction and 50 km/h in the other.In Łódź, our attention will be drawn to complicated methods of limiting speed, too short a left turn that makes it difficult to exit the roundabout during rush hours, and an intersection that pretends to be a roundabout.

programme.title: Road absurdities 4
programme.desc: In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face. In Zgierz we will see a pole at the entrance to the garage, in Łowicz - the intersection of a pedestrian crossing with a parking lot, in Łódź - the original exit from the parking lot which is the main road, and in Karczew - a pedestrian crossing at the exit of two access roads.In Warsaw, Kamil and Krzysiek will try to read the small print on the sign under the sign while driving at the legal speed of 70 km/h, they will evaluate the use of an innovative safe end solution, they will visit a bicycle path with occasional pedestrian crossings, they will look for the reason for blocking three parking spaces in the center, and in Rembertów they will encounter a pole in the middle of the road.

programme.desc: For the third time we will have the opportunity to look at German expressways.This time, the creators of the program take us from the A2 motorway to the A8 motorway.The 505-kilometer route starts in Perl, passes through Karlsruhe, Stuttgart, Augsburg and Munich, reaching all the way to the border with Austria.This road is one of the most important East-West connections in Central Europe.We will be able to see the work of the police, truck drivers, highway maintenance services, and engineers whose task is to smooth traffic.

programme.desc: Switch On - Across developing Africa, Asia and Latin America, billions of people suffer from the lack of safe and reliable energy—impacting literacy and education, water and food supply, communication, healthcare and the economy. Inspiring leaders, entrepreneurs, and everyday citizens are standing up to bring power to their people. Join Dr. Scott Tinker on an amazing global adventure to meet people and communities as they Switch On. It's a journey that's enlightening and emotional, uplifting and unforgettable. Switch On will change the way you look at energy and the developing world forever.

Cross Nepal with an environmental health scientist, studying people's transition from the most dangerous cooking fuel, killing millions a year, to the safest. And bring solar electricity, for the first time ever, to the Arhuaco people of Northern Colombia. Watch this 7-part series, based on and expanded from the celebrated global energy documentary Switch On– a spectacular, unexpected journey to know and understand the issues driving energy development around the world.

programme.title: Hasna Mana Hai
programme.desc: There is a locality in the old city of Lahore where a young man (Host: Tabish Hashmi) has come to reside from Karachi. He is the guy who has reside in Canada too, so there is a double introduction with his name. This locality is basically a pulse of society in that almost all the segments are presents. The young man (Host) tries to understand the eccentric behavior of the people around and in doing so inadvertently offers himself to mock at. The host brings to light the fact that the morals are customs more preached than practiced while traditions are customs more practiced than preached. Gradually the host will lay bare the sensibility, psyche and sensitivity of different characters thus giving the viewers insight into the show storyline. The viewers come to know of perplexing paradoxes in the funniest way possible. In every new episode the locality is entrapped into a tricky situation which they are struggling to come out of employing street smart tactics. Notwithstanding with the fact that they condemn every other person, institution, norm and policy of the government but they exactly do contrarily to what they profess. The issues of the community revolve around small scale corruption, partisanship, political misadventures, jealousy, interference, snobbery, belittling others. They keep taunting one another using tongue in cheek remarks thus manifesting a past perennially plagued with street power struggle, political affiliation, and proclivity for easy money and predisposition to the influence. There are two different strands lurking parallel to each other in the show. The host has to entertain the audience by introducing them to socio-political anecdotes, guests, short skits, weird people, achievers, trivial but tantalizing smaller wins, social eccentricity, literary uniqueness, cultural exclusivity, musical performance, parodying, stand up comedy etc and still the other strand runs on the floor as the main subject of the show - the drama being played out by the permanent characters of the show. These permanent characters are Pehalwan, Policeman, Professor, Pehalwan's daughter, a wannabe actress, a foreign returned Pakistani, Pehalwan's wife, a shop keeper, a poet, a fatman (an idle youth), a girl singer. The show will be divided into different segments but this segmentation is not conventional. The segments will only be announced in terms of the introduction of characters or performance if need be. Usually the characters will come on their own giving an impression as if they are unwanted though the host is quite familiar with them and poses as if their forced entry is not highly welcomed.

programme.title: Case No.9
programme.desc: Case No 9 is an inspiring story of Sehar, a courageous and ambitious young woman who challenges societal norms and becomes a beacon of resistance for others. Sehar, confident and driven, joins the company of Kamran, a domineering businessman feared by everyone for his egoistic and controlling nature. Unlike others, Sehar refuses to conform, letting her talent and integrity shine. Sehar’s defiance unsettles Kamran, who sets out to teach her a lesson. What follows is Sehar’s journey of redemption and resilience as she navigates the challenges thrown her way. Will Kamran succeed in teaching Sehar a lesson, or will she rise above his schemes? Can Sehar find the strength and support to overcome the odds, or will Kamran’s wealth and influence prove insurmountable? Geo and 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Shaidai
programme.desc: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Pehli Barish
programme.desc: Pehli Barish is a story of love that spans generations, a tale of joy, longing, and heartbreak that seems to repeat itself. Years ago in Lahore, strangers Behzad and Maleeha met and a spark of love lit between them. But fate had other plans and tore them apart, leaving hearts scarred. Decades later, Behzad lives a settled life with a family, yet the past never truly leaves him. His son, Maani, falls for Nimra and the shadows of old heartbreak loom large. As Behzad watches history threatening to repeat itself, he must face his own past to protect Maani and perhaps confront the love he lost long ago. Will Maleeha return to Behzad’s life? Will Behzad save his son from the same heartbreak he experienced? Can Maani and Nimra’s love win against all odds? GEO & 7th Sky Entertainment presentation

programme.title: Milkiyat
programme.desc: Geo Entertainment provides Pakistani dramas, family serials, reality shows, and general entertainment programming.

programme.title: Khush Naseebi
programme.desc: Khush Naseebi is a heartfelt story of Siraj Qasmi and his three daughters, Narmeen, Maheen, and Emaan. Siraj Qasmi is a widower who loves his daughters deeply. Narmeen and Maheen are the light of his life, but his heart remains distant from his youngest, Emaan. He carries a silent belief that her birth took away his wife, and that shadow has never left their relationship. In the same neighborhood lives Humayun, a hardworking tailor and Siraj’s favorite. He quietly loves Narmeen, but keeps his feelings hidden, believing he is not worthy of her. Like every father, Siraj dreams of seeing his daughters happily married. But before he can fulfill this wish, destiny knocks on his door. What does fate have in store for Siraj Qasmi? Will Humayun finally confess his love to Narmeen? And will Narmeen ever realize how deeply he loves her? Geo Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Humrahi
programme.desc: What begins as a series of light-hearted yet unpleasant encounters between Sayhaan and Elif eventually blossoms into an unexpected and deep-rooted love. Just as they begin to find their footing together, the life of Sayhaan Ghazi is suddenly upended by a storm he did not create. When an unforeseen crisis strikes, the two pillars of his existence—his devoted love, Elif, and his formidable father—are forced to face an impossible ultimatum. Driven by a desperate, protective instinct, they make a difficult choice to shield him from a reality they believe would be his undoing. However, this well-intentioned sacrifice triggers a catastrophic chain of events, turning their home into a place of chilling distance and lifelong regret. It is a haunting exploration of how the choices made for those we love can ultimately become the very walls that permanently divide a family. Will Sayhaan’s journey forward be defined by the choices others made, or will he find a way to reclaim his own destiny? What does life look like for Elif and Sayhaan’s father when the person they tried to protect can no longer look them in the eye? Director &

programme.title: Behkaway
programme.desc: In a world where desires blur the lines between right and wrong, one man’s pursuit of happiness sets off a chain of irreversible consequences. Zubair, a middle-aged man hardened by ego and entitlement, rules over his household with an iron hand. His wife, Zeenat, bears the weight of his injustices in silence, enduring not only his coldness but the cruelty of his mother and sister. Despite her unwavering love and devotion, Zeenat receives nothing but pain in return. But everything begins to shift when Zubair encounters Sitara, a young, captivating woman whose charm ignites a dangerous spark within him. Driven by selfish desires, Zubair makes a decision that sets off a ripple effect far beyond his control. Will Zubair abandon Zeenat after meeting Sitara? Will his decision have consequences for his family? And will Sitara prove to be a blessing or a nightmare in disguise for him? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

Decades later, Behzad lives a settled life with a family, yet the past never truly leaves him. His son, Maani, falls for Nimra and the shadows of old heartbreak loom large. As Behzad watches history threatening to repeat itself, he must face his own past to protect Maani and perhaps confront the love he lost long ago. Will Maleeha return to Behzad’s life? Will Behzad save his son from the same heartbreak he experienced? Can Maani and Nimra’s love win against all odds? GEO & 7th Sky Entertainment presentation

programme.title: Shaidai
programme.desc: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Jodi Ban Gayi
programme.desc: Rohan visits his grandfather, Jalal, during his vacation and they form a strong bond. However, Rohan is concerned about Jalal's loneliness and decides to find him a companion. His eyes fall on Zubi, a charming single lady who lives with her niece, Mahrukh, in the neighborhood. Rohan devises a plan to win Zubi's affection to gain entry into their home and Mahrukh's heart. However, his scheme is jeopardized when Mahrukh's mother arranges a marriage proposal from Faizi for Mahrukh. To thwart this, Mahrukh and Rohan pretend to be a couple in front of her mother to prevent the marriage to Faizi. Will Mahrukh genuinely fall for Rohan, or will their relationship remain just an act? Will Mahrukh have to marry someone else? How will Rohan stop Mahrukh’s impending marriage?

programme.title: Humrahi
programme.desc: What begins as a series of light-hearted yet unpleasant encounters between Sayhaan and Elif eventually blossoms into an unexpected and deep-rooted love. Just as they begin to find their footing together, the life of Sayhaan Ghazi is suddenly upended by a storm he did not create. When an unforeseen crisis strikes, the two pillars of his existence—his devoted love, Elif, and his formidable father—are forced to face an impossible ultimatum. Driven by a desperate, protective instinct, they make a difficult choice to shield him from a reality they believe would be his undoing. However, this well-intentioned sacrifice triggers a catastrophic chain of events, turning their home into a place of chilling distance and lifelong regret. It is a haunting exploration of how the choices made for those we love can ultimately become the very walls that permanently divide a family. Will Sayhaan’s journey forward be defined by the choices others made, or will he find a way to reclaim his own destiny? What does life look like for Elif and Sayhaan’s father when the person they tried to protect can no longer look them in the eye? Director &

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Chaal
programme.desc: Shokat and Sami are best friends, and Shokat is in love with Sabeen, Sami’s sister. However, due to the schemes of a fellow student Shaista, Shokat begins to mistrust Sabeen and leaves her to marry Shaista. Feeling betrayed, Shokat ends his friendship with Sami, turning them into enemies. Years later, Shokat and Sami are successful industrialists who still don’t see eye to eye. Fate intervenes when Shokat’s son, Rahil, and Sami’s daughter, Alina, fall in love despite their fathers’ enmity. For the sake of their children, Sami and Shokat agree to Rahil and Alina’s marriage. However, Sami sets a condition: the marriage will only happen if Shokat’s daughter, Rubab, marries Sami’s son, Sikandar. Although intended to prevent the marriage, unforeseen circumstances led both families to agree, resulting in the marriages of both Rahil and Alina, as well as Rubab and Sikandar. Can Rubab and Sikandar accept each other? Will their children’s marriage end the feud between Sami and Shokat? Will Rubab and Sikandar have a joyful marriage? Will Alina and Rahil help them understand one another?

programme.desc: This is a story of a young girl named Dil Awaiz who despite living in her father’s house is treated as an orphan and is deprived of love and care. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Nadaaniyaan
programme.desc: Geo Kahani provides Pakistani drama serials, family entertainment, and storytelling-focused programming.

programme.title: Dolly Darling
programme.desc: Dolly is a drama queen and an extrovert; while her husband is just the opposite, an introvert. Also her obsession and endless love for husband simply drives him nuts. But then Dolly has her own quirky talents. She is a bundle of nerves, always bubbling with boundless energy and blessed with a quick mind and a razor sharp tongue. A stylish, lively, naive and innocent Dolly does everything and goes to every extent to captivate her husband, to become his sweetheart and a darling. But at the end of the day it is not meant to be so and she fails to make an impression on her husband. So she has a smart plan She intelligently influences the people around her and the individuals in her daily life to become the star she always wanted to be for her husband, the heroine; Dolly Darling.

programme.title: Chaal
programme.desc: Shokat and Sami are best friends, and Shokat is in love with Sabeen, Sami’s sister. However, due to the schemes of a fellow student Shaista, Shokat begins to mistrust Sabeen and leaves her to marry Shaista. Feeling betrayed, Shokat ends his friendship with Sami, turning them into enemies. Years later, Shokat and Sami are successful industrialists who still don’t see eye to eye. Fate intervenes when Shokat’s son, Rahil, and Sami’s daughter, Alina, fall in love despite their fathers’ enmity. For the sake of their children, Sami and Shokat agree to Rahil and Alina’s marriage. However, Sami sets a condition: the marriage will only happen if Shokat’s daughter, Rubab, marries Sami’s son, Sikandar. Although intended to prevent the marriage, unforeseen circumstances led both families to agree, resulting in the marriages of both Rahil and Alina, as well as Rubab and Sikandar. Can Rubab and Sikandar accept each other? Will their children’s marriage end the feud between Sami and Shokat? Will Rubab and Sikandar have a joyful marriage? Will Alina and Rahil help them understand one another?

programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

With her 30th birthday looming and being forced to re-enter the New York City dating scene, she feels adrift in a cold world. She leans on her friends (Zoe Lister-Jones, Hamish Linklater) for support but, after a series of romantic humiliations, professional blunders and boozy antics, Lola realizes that she alone is in charge of her fate.
